Balaji Amines Limited stands as one of India's leading manufacturers of aliphatic amines and specialty chemicals, headquartered at 165-A Railway Lines, Solapur - 413001, Maharashtra. Established in 1988, the company has evolved into a prominent player in the global chemical industry, with a strong focus on manufacturing methylamines, ethylamines, and their derivatives, along with specialty chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates.

The company operates multiple state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities strategically located across India, employing advanced technology and maintaining stringent quality standards. Balaji Amines has built its reputation on delivering high-quality products that cater to diverse industries including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, rubber chemicals, water treatment, textiles, and personal care. Their extensive product portfolio comprises over 25 different amines and derivatives, making them one of the most comprehensive amine manufacturers in Asia.

With a commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility, Balaji Amines has implemented eco-friendly manufacturing processes and maintains various international certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001. The company's robust research and development initiatives focus on innovation and process optimization, enabling them to meet evolving market demands. Their products are exported to numerous countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, establishing Balaji Amines as a trusted global supplier in the specialty chemicals sector.
